title: Repeated Service Level Breaches and the Service Level Credit (Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement)
content:
Repeated breaches raise the service level credit for the latest census month under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. Where at least 2 service level credits were booked on the agreement on entry dates from which fewer than 6 whole months have passed to today, the credit percentage is multiplied by 1.2; where exactly 1 was, by 1.1; otherwise it is not multiplied.

A whole month from an entry date is reached on the same day of the month as the entry date, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day; the count is of service level credits already booked on the agreement.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical, today being the 20th of a month)

| Service level credits already booked | Within the window | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| one booked 2 months ago, one booked 5 months ago | both | 1.2 |
| one booked on the 21st, 6 calendar months earlier | yes: 5 whole months have passed | 1.1 |
| one booked on the 20th, 6 calendar months earlier | no: 6 whole months have passed | none |
| none | none | none |
